1.title: Trump reveals millions of dollars' worth of share deals in big tech and AI
1.summary: Stock in major firms such as Microsoft, Nvidia and SpaceX was bought and sold on behalf of the US president.

2.title: ICE Mistakenly Detains U.S. Citizen in Chicago Area, Leaving Him Injured
2.summary: The Department of Homeland Security said agents released the man after he identified himself. He was taken to the hospital on Sunday with head and neck injuries, local police said.

3.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault
3.summary: In court, Miriam Haley said the assault had a "devastating effect on my life and sense of security that may never go away".

4.title: U.N. Live Updates: Iran’s President Accuses U.S. and Israel of Lawless Attacks in a Defiant Address
4.summary: Masoud Pezeshkian said Iran was open to diplomacy but would never accept limits on its civilian nuclear program. Before his speech later today, President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine called on allies to apply more pressure on Russia.

5.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
5.summary: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.

6.title: Ancient Wall Found in Paris Provides Clues to City’s Origins
6.summary: A discovery at a Parisian hospital, on an island in the Seine, has given archaeologists clues about the city as Julius Caesar may have found it.
